intent: Feature signal store. Injects DashboardApi and ToastStore. load() fetches ratios, phases and steps (routineId 'default') with forkJoin; resetRatios() calls resetTrainingRatios and shows toast 'Comparative metrics reset' ('info'). API contract: DashboardApi (providedIn root) { getTrainingRatios(): Observable<TrainingRatio[]>; resetTrainingRatios(): Observable<TrainingRatio[]>; getPhases(): Observable<PhaseProgress[]>; getSteps(routineId: string): Observable<WorkoutStep[]> } ; ToastStore (providedIn root) { readonly toasts: Signal<readonly Notification[]>; show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string; dismiss(id: string): void; clear(): void }. Public API exactly: DashboardStore (providedIn root) { readonly ratios: Signal<readonly TrainingRatio[]>; readonly phases: Signal<readonly PhaseProgress[]>; readonly steps: Signal<readonly WorkoutStep[]>; readonly loading: Signal<boolean>; readonly error: Signal<string | null>; load(): void; resetRatios(): void }.
